verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms https://docs.vapi.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an explicit "Instructions for AI Agents" section, and it tells agents to append `.md` to any page URL for clean Markdown. Every cited docs page is served this way. The CLI docs also claim IDE AI assistants (Cursor, Windsurf, VSCode) get accurate knowledge of Vapi's APIs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents use these docs effectively in practice, and no evidence of a full-content variant such as llms-full.txt.
